column3: Close to the Greek; “vinegar” is rendered “sour wine.”
NKJV has “cried out like this and breathed His last,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “saw that He thus breathed His last.” NKJV has “the Son of God”; the Greek has no article.
NKJV has “the body,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the corpse.”
